title: Google's AI ranks #1 for predicting flu hospitalizations.
gist: Per Google, a flu forecasting model built with its Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) tool ranked best of 39 eligible models in the CDC's FluSight 2025-26 end-of-season analysis of U.S. flu hospital admissions. Google positions ERA, an AI system that generates optimization algorithms across scientific fields, as validated and now available to trusted testers.

insights.claim: In the CDC's FluSight end-of-season analysis for 2025-26, Google's best flu forecasting model most closely matched observed U.S. flu hospital admissions out of 39 eligible models.
insights.speaker: Zahra Shamsi
insights.so_what: An independent, government-run head-to-head benchmark gives Google's AI-for-science claims credibility beyond self-reported results.
insights.quote: of 39 eligible models, Google’s best matched the season’s observed hospital admissions
insights.locator: The end-of-season analysis published this week

insights.claim: CDC FluSight aggregates weekly forecasts from government, industry and academic teams from October through May, predicting U.S. hospital admissions for the current week and three weeks ahead, and uses the combined forecast to communicate expected state-level demand for medical services.
insights.speaker: Zahra Shamsi
insights.so_what: Public-health ensemble forecasting is an open competitive arena where AI vendors can demonstrate value to health-system and government buyers.
insights.locator: From October through May, the CDC’s FluSight

insights.claim: Google's winning flu forecasts were developed using Empirical Research Assistance (ERA), an AI tool that generates optimization algorithms across a range of scientific fields, implying the result comes from a general-purpose method rather than a bespoke epidemiology model.
insights.speaker: Zahra Shamsi
insights.so_what: If a general algorithm-generating tool can beat domain specialists, AI-for-science could scale across many forecasting and optimization verticals.
insights.quote: an AI tool that generates optimization algorithms across a range of scientific fields
insights.locator: Google forecasts were developed using Empirical

insights.claim: Google says ERA research was published in Nature and that ERA's underlying technology is now available to trusted testers as part of its experimental science tools, signalling an early path toward productization.
insights.speaker: Zahra Shamsi
insights.so_what: Watch for ERA moving from trusted-tester access to a commercial scientific-tools offering within Google's AI/cloud stack.
insights.locator: ERA’s underlying technology is now available

insights.claim: Google frames the FluSight result as validation that AI combined with human ingenuity will improve disease forecasting worldwide.
insights.speaker: Zahra Shamsi
insights.so_what: Signals Google's intent to extend AI forecasting into global public-health and disease surveillance markets.
insights.quote: AI combined with human ingenuity will improve our ability to forecast diseases worldwide
